outcome_evidence: The robot approaches the drawer cabinet and aligns its gripper with the silver handle (frames 50–85, wrist_image and left_ego_image). It then pulls the drawer outward, visibly exposing the drawer interior and sides (frames 113–124, image and left_ego_image). The gripper releases and withdraws while the drawer remains open through frame 176 (frames 149–176, wrist_image and image). No failed acquisition, unintended object displacement, or harmful side effect is visible.
